channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Road Wars
channel.desc: A cyclist and a biker confront each other in Minnesota; shots are fired during a road rage altercation at a gas station in Florida; a toddler in Oklahoma has a run-in with the law; a station wagon and a pickup face off in Missouri; a motorcyclist in Canada has a terrifying mishap on an overpass; in China, a leak at a gas station sparks a blaze.
